graduation_criteria.description: Discovery → Deployment 전환 조건. discovery_graduation_gate.sh 강제. v8.x WS2 재설계(2026-05-29): rank-IC 계열은 long-only 실현 alpha와 어긋나(16후보 calibration 실측: rank_ic가 FLOW 거짓탈락+NN/TECH 거짓통과) advisory로 강등, portfolio-alpha t(forge NW lag-3)를 hard로. DSR hard는 sweep형 selection만(2026-06-10 개정 — chain/단일은 advisory). hard 기준은 forge-authoritative 값(alpha-stage proxy 아님)에 적용.
graduation_criteria.min_rank_ic_rationale: KR top-universe benchmark. <0.04는 IC 약함. (v8.x severity=advisory — long-only 실현 alpha 미전이)
graduation_criteria.max_drawdown_days_rationale: 100일 이상 drawdown 지속 시 alpha decay 의심. (severity=advisory)
graduation_criteria.min_harvey_t_stat_rationale: rank-IC Harvey-t. (v8.x severity=advisory — rank-IC t는 portfolio-alpha t와 구분, 후자가 권위)
graduation_criteria.min_deflated_sharpe_ratio_rationale: Bailey-Lopez de Prado DSR — multi-testing 보정 SR. (severity=HARD는 sweep형 selection만 — ML스윕/optimizer서치/앙상블·사전등록 grid. 가설주도 chain/단일검증은 advisory 강등+진단산출. 도훈 mandate 2026-05-31/2026-06-10, measurement-graduation §3)
graduation_criteria.min_portfolio_alpha_t_nw_rationale: ★v8.x 신규 HARD. forge-authoritative 실현 portfolio-alpha t (NW lag-3, forge_package.portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3). Harvey-Liu-Zhu 2016 hurdle. rank-IC t 아님. 게이트 핵심 판별(16후보 중 FLOW만 통과=정확).
graduation_criteria.severity_rationale: hard = block(우회불가), advisory = warn(screening). hard 2종(DSR/portfolio_alpha_t_nw)은 forge-authoritative 값에만 적용 — alpha-stage proxy로 graduation 선언 금지(v8.x WS1 정합).

hypothesis_description:
FROM the TOP-CONCENTRATION targeted re-ideation (kr-topconc-momentum-hunt: 32 concepts, designed from the 9-concept campaign learning that real signals were ALL short/mid-decile -> AX-007). M_BuybackDrift_Confirmed = top-feasibility Tier-A (top_conc=5, feasibility=5; cached PIT-clean data). FULL build-ready spec at stage_artifacts/momentum_hunt/backlog_topconc.json -> specs[name='M_BuybackDrift_Confirmed']. READ IT and FOLLOW build_steps 1-11.

CONCEPT (genuinely novel, BUY-SIDE, top-concentration-designed): cross-sectional BUYBACK YIELD = TTM 4-quarter treasury-stock/buyback KRW notional (.cache/stock_buyback.parquet) normalized by Size, gated by M03 momentum CONFIRM (> cross-sectional median), equal-weight top-25. NO M* factor uses buyback. Mechanism: a buyback = costly credible insider commitment + mechanical demand bid + post-announcement underreaction drift (Ikenberry); M03 gate filters defensive value-trap buybacks. Buy-side only -> directly escapes the AX-007 no-short trap that left the prior 9 real signals stranded in short/mid-decile.

DATA REFRAME (workflow already verified — do NOT re-discover): stock_buyback.parquet is a QUARTERLY PANEL (302k rows, Value = buyback KRW/quarter, ~7.1% nonzero, Factor_Date = Period_Date + 45d, C4-clean), NOT a binary event log. So this is buyback-yield rank carried across the quarter, restricted to the ACTIVE-signal subset (drop score==0 BEFORE ranking deciles).

WHY NOW: the 9-concept campaign proved the wall is AX-007 (real signals all short/mid-decile, top-20 cannot harvest). THIS concept is engineered for top-concentration: restricting to buyback firms + M03 confirm gives a flat baseline with the alpha concentrated in the active-signal top. KR Value-up program (2023+) makes buybacks well-populated and timely.

TOP-CONCENTRATION TEST (mandatory, the make-or-break, per spec top_concentration_test): drop score==0 before decile ranking; verify D10 (highest buyback-yield-confirmed) earns REAL net active return with a SIGNIFICANT top-decile t-stat and positive D10-D9 gap — NOT flat/short. honest_risk #1 = TOP-GOES-FLAT (KR buybacks often defensive value-traps); the decile D10-D9 gap + spike-survival split are the early detectors.

ORTHOGONALITY (active -BM basis, per spec; gross will read ~0.7 from shared market beta per measurement-graduation §6 — report ACTIVE correlation as binding): vs M03/M06/M12 momentum |corr|<=0.40 (prove not just momentum-beta), vs value/EP |corr|<=0.35 (buyback firms skew value -> prove buyback-specific not value-beta), vs Size <=0.35.

ABLATIONS (build_step 11): (i) buyback yield WITHOUT confirm gate, (ii) WITH gate, (iii) raw KRW un-normalized (prove Size-normalization matters), (iv) gate with M06/M12. Report gate FILL-FREQUENCY — if <25 names pass often and it falls back to ungated fill, the 'confirmed' label dilutes (honest_risk #2).

EXPECTED_ROLE: core/offensive BUY-SIDE event-driven momentum, top-concentration-designed (first such in the campaign). PIT/CONSTRAINTS: Factor_Date+45d asof-join only (C4), forward Ret_1m (C2), cross-sectional median/rank per-month (C1 no full-sample), C13 Z_Score_Aligned, C14, C15. long-only top-25, weight [0,0.20], 15bps, 2e8 liq. n_trials~1 single hypothesis (DSR exempt selection_type='single'; overfit defense = oos_retention>=0.7 + holdout falsification). real-computation (canonical_screen_bt) ONLY; proxy hand-calc forbidden. Codex Critic Round mandatory.

HONEST RISK (AX-000 amended): TOP-GOES-FLAT (value-trap buybacks), gate over-thinning, momentum redundancy. Graduation NOT presumed; real-but-non-graduating -> screen-route (OVERLAY/FR/DPL). A clean negative is success; but this is the campaign's first genuinely top-concentration-designed candidate so the decile test is the key read. RAWDATA.parquet has BM_Ret column (KOSPI200 TR) per spec; if empty use .cache/benchmark.parquet. R segfault guard (single-thread, kill stray Rscript, file-based).
